historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved with conditions conditional use authorization to install twelve receive-only parabolic antennas on the roof of the building and three monopole antenna towers attached to the north side of the building, 6-0.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved demolishing an industrial building and constructing a new approximately 87,000 square foot industrial building, 5-0.
An industrial building stood on the site.
